before.name: Juan Muñoz
before.description: Juan Muñoz is an Oak Park Township trustee who attended a protest at the Broadview immigration detention facility on October 3, 2025. In a sworn declaration, he said federal agents arrested him while he filmed the protest. He was held inside the facility and released that afternoon at a nearby gas station. His declaration described approximately eight hours in custody and the chilling effect of the arrest on his participation in protests.
